long_biography.plain_text:
In 2019, Gerrit Malipaard's Euro Products acquired A.C. de Jong en Zoon, the cleaning-products business where he had learned his trade under Eduard de Jong. He wanted his former employer to retain its identity within the group, while the two businesses made use of their complementary strengths.

In Maassluis, he also bought a disused waterfront office building and arranged its conversion into a hotel. The premises had previously housed the pilotage service and a towage company. Hotel Maassluis opened in 2018, with Floris van Vliet running the hotel and restaurant.
